They are arranged opposite in pairs and tendrils arise at the ends of the leaf stalks.  In late spring, the spectacular 1.5in (3.8cm) trumpet flowers are borne terminally or along the branches.  The flowers are pale lavender and delicately detailed with dark violet and purple veins.  Flowers are followed by large prickly seed pods.  This evergreen ornamental plant easily reaches to 16 feet and is a carefree grower.  It has only recently been moved out of the genus "Pandorea".
